p: Once upon a time,there lived a girl in Busolwe village called Namagunga.
She liked flowers so much.one day she went to fetch water from river Nakwiga.
On her way, she found flowers which she admired so much, waooooo! she said.
When she returned she told her mother to also plan flowers at their home because.............
On our dresses we find flowers.
On our shoes we find flowers.
